title: A refused file renders an aria-describedby-bound error and moves focus to its retry control, without sending the bytes
asA: operator whose selected file is refused by the MIME gate, the size gate or the virus scanner
iWant: an inline error that names the refusal reason, is bound to my file row via aria-describedby, and moves my focus to the retry control without sending the file to the server
soThat: I learn why the file was refused, do not waste my upload budget on a refused file, and can retry with a corrected file from my keyboard

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the fixture is seeded with a refused file (MIME mismatch, size cap exceeded, or virus-scan hit), the file row [data-file-row][data-refused="true"] renders a [data-error-message] element whose id is referenced by the row's aria-describedby attribute, the row exposes the closed refusal reason via [data-refusal-reason] (one of mime-refused, size-refused, virus-refused), a [data-recovery="retry"] control receives keyboard focus, and the pack observes zero POST or PATCH requests carrying the refused filename on the browser's request log.
